title: Give prospective residents a costs document
what: Give a prospective resident who asks for one a prospective costs document (the estimated costs of moving in, living in and leaving) within 7 days.

sources.title: Retirement Villages Act 1999 (Qld)
sources.quote: If a prospective resident asks a scheme operator for a prospective costs document, the operator must prepare and give to the prospective resident a prospective costs document within 7 days after receiving from the prospective resident any information that the operator needs to complete the document

administration.who: Chief executive of the department administering the Retirement Villages Act 1999 (Qld)

sources.title: Retirement Villages Act 1999 (Qld)
sources.locator: s 28, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026) (current)
sources.quote: The chief executive may register, or refuse to register, a retirement village scheme for which an application for registration has been made.

reach.condition: if it operates a retirement village
